serviceDesk.title: Service Desk
serviceDesk.body: Need further assistance after searching for self-service solutions above? Contact a Service Desk agent for live 24/7 IT support no matter where you are located.

modal.title: Did you know?
modal.searchArticleContent: i-o offers hundreds of helpful articles and solutions.
modal.chatNowContent: Chatting with an agent has lower queue times and is quicker than a phone call.

lounge.title: i-o Lounge
lounge.body: Need on-site support? i-o Lounge provides dedicated IT support at selected sites worldwide. Users at these sites can either walk-up to a lounge or schedule an appointment.

mdp.title: i-o District Partner
mdp.body: Have a business IT or workplace technology need? Your i-o District Partner supports CoreTech managed products and services at your site. Contact your MDP for end-to-end IT support, training, and escalations at the site level.
